content: <thought>Based on the mass (C11H15NO2) and 13C NMR (aromatic six carbons, carbonyl at 166 ppm, and four aliphatic carbons at 52.2, 49.6, 43.6, 19.2 ppm), the molecule is a benzamide bearing an N‑alkyl side chain. The aliphatic carbon shifts correspond to a –CH2–CH2–CH(CH3)– fragment attached to the nitrogen (CH2‑N ≈ 52 ppm, CH2‑CH2 ≈ 49 ppm, CH attached to N ≈ 44 ppm, methyl ≈ 19 ppm). This fits the structure N‑(1‑methylpropyl)‑benzamide (also called N‑isobutyl‑benzamide). The SMILES for this compound is **CC(C)CNC(=O)c1ccccc1**.
